## Summary

### Overview

- A 2PL model with 1 dimension was fitted to 1200 respondents and 31
  items (EM estimation).
- The estimation converged normally.

### Model fit

- Overall model fit is close: M2 = 561.36, df = 434, RMSEA = 0.016, CFI
  = 0.987, SRMSR = 0.030.
- The chi-square test is significant, but with large samples this is
  common; the RMSEA indicates the misfit is small in practical terms.

### Reliability

- Marginal reliability is 0.83 (good).

### Targeting

- The average item location is -0.18 and the average person score is
  -0.00, so the test is well targeted for this group.
- Measurement is most precise around theta = -0.52 (information = 6.04,
  SE = 0.41).

### Items

- Low discrimination: Q12 (a = 0.42), Q30 (a = 0.43), Q32 (a = 0.47).
  These items barely separate high and low scorers; review the key and
  wording.
- Extreme location: Q32 (b = 3.05). These items are far too easy or too
  hard for most respondents.
- Low item-total correlation: Q12 (r = 0.16), Q21 (r = 0.19), Q30 (r =
  0.19), Q32 (r = 0.17). These items relate weakly to the rest of the
  test.
- Misfit: Q04 (S-X2 p = .004), Q12 (S-X2 p = .002), Q17 (S-X2 p = .002).
  The model does not describe responses to these items well (alpha =
  0.01); inspect them with gg_empirical() or item_card().

### Local dependence

- 1 item pair shows possible local dependence (Q3 exceeds the average of
  -0.03 by more than 0.2).
- Strongest: Q21 & Q22 (Q3 = 0.27).
- Check whether these items share a stimulus, wording, or content;
  consider a testlet or bifactor model.

### Person fit

- 1.8% of respondents have unusual response patterns (Zh \< -1.96),
  which is within what chance alone would produce.

## Blueprint

Construct: Professional knowledge for certification. Test takers: not
stated. Score use: pass/fail certification. Forms have 12 items
(multiple choice); target reliability 0.85.

| content  | cognitive | n   |
|----------|-----------|-----|
| Ethics   | NA        | 4   |
| Practice | NA        | 5   |
| Law      | NA        | 3   |

## Field-test design

The field test uses 2 form(s) of 18 items, each taken by 600 test
takers, with 4 anchor items on every form, for calibration with the 2PL
model.

In 2 simulated field tests the slopes were recovered with an RMSE of
0.22 and the intercepts with an RMSE of 0.12.

| form | role   | item |
|------|--------|------|
| 1    | anchor | 4    |
| 2    | anchor | 4    |
| 1    | unique | 14   |
| 2    | unique | 14   |

| English | 750 | 0.118      | 0.913    | 0.411   |
| French  | 450 | -0.198     | 0.878    | 0.402   |

## Cut scores

1 cut score(s) on the summed-score scale divide test takers into Fail,
Pass. Decision quality was estimated by the method of Lee (2010) for the
calibrated test, over 1,200 abilities: classification accuracy 0.861,
consistency 0.809 (kappa 0.61).

### Cuts

| cut | label | theta | raw | sem   |
|-----|-------|-------|-----|-------|
| 1   | Pass  | 0.157 | 18  | 0.421 |

### Decision quality by cut

| cut | label | accuracy | consistency | kappa | false_positive | false_negative |
|-----|-------|----------|-------------|-------|----------------|----------------|
| 1   | Pass  | 0.861    | 0.809       | 0.613 | 0.095          | 0.044          |

### Expected share in each category

| category | expected | true  |
|----------|----------|-------|
| Fail     | 0.555    | 0.606 |
| Pass     | 0.445    | 0.394 |

## Scoring

Test takers were scored by EAP: mean ability -0.00 (SD 0.91), median
standard error 0.39.

## Test security

Security checks run: preknowledge, answer copying. Security flags are
evidence for an investigation, not proof of misconduct; individual test
takers are not named in this report.

No test taker showed evidence.

## Pipeline decisions

Every stage ran its checks and raised flags for review. Flags only
warned (strict = FALSE). 9 flag(s) were raised; 1 are still open and 8
were acknowledged, overridden or fixed.

### Stages

| stage | status | summary |
|----|----|----|
| 0 Blueprint | done | 3 cells, 12 items per form |
| 1 Item generation | not run |  |
| 2 Item review | not run |  |
| 3 Field-test design | done | 2 forms of 18 items, 4 anchors, 1,200 test takers |
| 4 Data intake | done | 1,200 respondents, 32 items, scored with key |
| 5 Calibration | done | 2PL, converged, reliability 0.83 |
| 6 Linking and bank | done | 31 items added to the bank |
| 7 Forms | not run |  |
| 8 Cut scores | done | 1 cut, accuracy 0.86, consistency 0.81 |
| 9 Scoring | done | EAP scores for 1,200 test takers, reliability 0.83 |
| 10 Test security | done | 2 checks; 0 test takers with evidence |
| 11 Reporting | done | written to certification-technical-report.html |
| 12 Bank monitoring | not run |  |

### Flags

| id | level | stage | check | target | value | rule | status | note | advice |
|----|----|----|----|----|----|----|----|----|----|
| 2 | block | intake | possible_miskey | Q14 | p = 0.18, item-total r = -0.23 | p \< 0.1 or item-total r \< 0 | fixed | Item dropped: Key confirmed wrong by the item writer | Check the answer key and the item text; fix the key or drop the item. |
| 4 | block | calibration | dif_large | Q09 | MH D-DIF = -2.01, French vs English (favours English) | ETS category C | overridden | Translation reviewed; French version revised | Have a fairness panel review the item; drop or revise it unless the difference is construct-relevant. |
| 1 | review | field_test | recovery | design | RMSE of slopes = 0.22 | RMSE \<= 0.2 | acknowledged | Sample fixed by the testing window | Parameters would be estimated imprecisely; increase the sample per form or reduce the number of forms. |
| 3 | review | calibration | local_dependence | Q21 & Q22 | Q3 = 0.27 | \|Q3\| \> 0.2 | acknowledged | Q21 and Q22 share a case; keep them apart on forms | The items may share a stimulus or cue each other; review them together or treat them as a testlet. |
| 5 | review | calibration | dif_moderate | Q27 | MH D-DIF = -1.01, French vs English (favours English) | ETS category B | acknowledged | Sent to the bias panel | Review the item for content that may favour one group. |
| 6 | review | calibration | low_reliability | test | marginal reliability = 0.83 | reliability \< 0.85 | acknowledged | Operational forms will be longer than the field test | Scores are less precise than planned; add items or report wider score bands. |
| 8 | review | cuts | cut_precision | cut 1 (Pass) | SEM = 0.42 at theta = 0.16 | SEM \<= 0.35 | acknowledged | Add items near the cut to the operational forms | The test has little information at this cut; assemble forms targeted at it (assemble_forms(theta = cut)). |
| 9 | review | scoring | score_reliability | scores | empirical reliability = 0.83 | reliability \>= 0.85 | acknowledged | Field-test scores are not reported to candidates | Scores are less precise than the target; report score bands and consider a longer test. |
| 7 | info | calibration | person_misfit | 22 respondents | 1.8% of respondents | Zh \< -1.96 | open |  | About 2.5% are expected by chance; many more may point to guessing, cheating or careless responding. See p\$persons. |

## Reproducibility

Run this code to reproduce the analysis:

    library(mirtverse)
    p <- mv_pipeline(title = "Certification exam: Form A field test")
    p <- set_blueprint(p, cells = c(Ethics = 4, Practice = 5, Law = 3), construct = "Professional knowledge for certification", 
        use = "pass/fail certification", reliability = 0.85)
    p <- design_field_test(p, n_forms = 2, n_per_form = 600, items = 32, reps = 2, seed = 1)
    p <- acknowledge(p, check = "recovery", note = "Sample fixed by the testing window")
    p <- add_responses(p, data = certexam, items = 3:34, key = certexam_key, group = "language", 
        id = "id")
    p <- drop_items(p, items = "Q14", note = "Key confirmed wrong by the item writer")
    p <- calibrate(p, model = "2PL")
    p <- acknowledge(p, check = "local_dependence", note = "Q21 and Q22 share a case; keep them apart on forms")
    p <- override(p, check = "dif_large", note = "Translation reviewed; French version revised")
    p <- acknowledge(p, check = "dif_moderate", note = "Sent to the bias panel")
    p <- acknowledge(p, check = "low_reliability", note = "Operational forms will be longer than the field test")
    p <- bank_items(p, name = "Certification bank")
    p <- set_cuts(p, cuts = 18, scale = "raw", labels = c("Fail", "Pass"))
    p <- score_persons(p)
    p <- acknowledge(p, check = "cut_precision", note = "Add items near the cut to the operational forms")
    p <- acknowledge(p, check = "score_reliability", note = "Field-test scores are not reported to candidates")
    p <- check_security(p, leaked = c("Q01", "Q02", "Q03", "Q04", "Q05"))
    p <- pipeline_report(p, file = "pkgdown/assets/case-study/certification-technical-report.html", 
        title = "Certification exam, Form A: Technical report", author = "Psychometrics team (fictional example)", 
        open = FALSE)
